top_signals.title: BoK's Yoon: AI Concerns Add to Korea Equity Volatility
top_signals.summary: Bank of Korea Chief Economist Kyoungsoo Yoon believes concerns over artificial intelligence have added to volatility in South Korea's equity markets. He speaks with Haidi Stroud-Watts and Paul Allen on "Bloomberg: The Asia Trade". (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
